newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LEAGUE SPONSORS AGREE 200 PERCENT INCREASE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEAGUE SPONSORS AGREE 200 PERCENT INCREASE.

text.p: The sponsors of English soccer's premier league are to increase their cash input by 200 percent from next year.
The league announced a new 36 million pounds ($59.3 million) four-year sponsorship deal with brewers Bass on Monday.
It starts when the current 12 million pounds ($19.8 million) agreement over the last four years ends next northern summer.
League chief executive Rick Parry said: "We were in discussion with several other companies and there could have been even more money on the table.
"But the (20) clubs wanted continuity. It has been an excellent partnership (between Bass and league) and the clubs were unanimous in voting for its extension."
